title: Simultaneous clopen exceptional comparisons with one global functor at every coefficient stage
statement: Fix the purity datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in the fixed coefficient closure, and its integral, rational and algebraically closed constructible categories [def-pur-conventions, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Let $g:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and fix a compactification $c$ of $g$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $I$ be finite and let $j_i:X_i\to X$ be open and closed immersions from finite-type $k$-schemes whose images are pairwise disjoint and cover $X$ [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion]. For the normalized actual-system comparison records [def-pur-clopen-exceptional-all-coefficients], there exist a record $R$ for the identity inclusion $X\to X$ and records $R_i$ for all $j_i$, all for this same $c$, such that $R_i$ and $R$ have exactly the same global integral exceptional functor, the same global rational exceptional functor, and the same global common-stage exceptional functor. All records retain their strict-system and finite-evaluation coherence fields. No smoothness, section, orientation or tensor invertibility is assumed. Both empty components and the empty cover of the empty scheme are included.

proof.text: Use the fixed compactification c for the global source and precompose its open part with each j_i. The strict-system support construction supplies one global support system S and all component systems Si. Fix the global exceptional right adjoint G of S once; the component counit-adjoint comparison theorem applies to this same G for every i, and supplies the actual system isomorphisms and their finite evaluations. Include the identity inclusion with the same global S and G, using its identity adjoint comparison.

source.place: Final invertibility sentence, finite-clopen assembly: Step 3, simultaneous actual-system comparisons

proof.text: Realize the fixed global system on the pro-etale site and by its actual derived inverse limit once. For each component use the counit-normalized comparison and its inverse to define its integral restriction map. If a chosen component presentation uses an isomorphic global right adjoint, conjugate its comparison through the unique counit-preserving right-adjoint isomorphism, transporting its normalization equations as well. The global integral functor in every record is thus literally the fixed one, not just separately isomorphic to it. The strict square and finite evaluations commute by the system integral realization theorem.

source.place: Final invertibility sentence, finite-clopen assembly: Step 3, simultaneous actual-system comparisons

proof.text: Extend these same integral functors linearly on rational Homs. At every finite coefficient field repeat the common global choice; take transition maps to be the counit mates of the single fixed compact-support scalar action. The scalar descent theorem and mate pasting give identity/composition coherence and the stagewise component comparisons. The induced common-stage action, including its object and representative-arrow formulas, is consequently the same for all i and for the identity record. The global functor equalities are reflexive after these simultaneous choices. An empty index type requires only the identity record.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteClopen_common_exceptional
    {I : Type w} [Finite I]
    (Xi : I → Over (Spec (.of P.field.k)))
    [∀ i, LocallyOfFiniteType ((Xi i).left ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact ((Xi i).left ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    (j : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X)
    [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i).left] [∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (j i).left]
    (hdisjoint : ∀ i k, i ≠ k → Disjoint (Set.range (j i).left) (Set.range (j k).left))
    (hcover : (⋃ i, Set.range (j i).left) = Set.univ)
    (c : Compactification g) :
    ∃ R : ClopenExceptionalAllCoefficients P X Y X g c (𝟙 X),
      ∃ Ri : ∀ i, ClopenExceptionalAllCoefficients P X Y (Xi i) g c (j i),
        ∀ i, (Ri i).base.integral = R.base.integral ∧
          (Ri i).base.rational = R.base.rational ∧
          (Ri i).action.functor = R.action.functor
